_meta.name: Render Enhancement
_meta.description: Enhances architectural renders with realistic materials, lighting, reflections and planting while using the input image as the design reference.
_meta.license_notes: Uses the installed FLUX.2 Klein 4B image-edit workflow. Image generation is AI-based; exact geometry preservation is not guaranteed.

inputs.text: Enhance the uploaded architectural render into a photorealistic, high-end architectural visualization. Treat the source image as the fixed design reference. Preserve the visible building massing, floor count, structural grid, parking openings, ramps, façade proportions, window and door positions, signage, storefront layout, camera angle, perspective, and overall composition as closely as possible. Improve only material realism, concrete and stone texture, physically plausible glass reflections, metal finishes, natural daylight, shadows, planting, and surface detail. Maintain open parking façades and natural ventilation. Do not add or remove floors, move structural elements, close openings, or redesign the architecture.
